verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence for migration is a marketing-page exchange in which Attio says it will map existing deal history during onboarding and supply a migration checklist, moving off spreadsheets. That is a thin, vendor-assisted claim, not a documented migration tool. The REST API and SDK object actions for imports are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented CRM importer or migration tool, preservation of record owners, preservation of activity/interaction history from a source CRM, supported source-CRM list, independent or hands-on corroboration.
